name: How to Prepare Your Property for Luxury Real Estate Photography

step.name: Step 1: Deep Clean Everything – You'd be surprised what a camera picks up! Every surface should sparkle. This means floors, countertops, windows, mirrors, and fixtures. Don't forget small details like baseboards and light switches. A spotless home conveys meticulous care and highlights its best features.
step.text: Step 1: Deep Clean Everything – You'd be surprised what a camera picks up! Every surface should sparkle. This means floors, countertops, windows, mirrors, and fixtures. Don't forget small details like baseboards and light switches. A spotless home conveys meticulous care and highlights its best features.

step.name: Step 2: Declutter and Depersonalize – Clear out all personal items like family photos, excessive knick-knacks, and toiletries. Remove magnets from the fridge and clear off countertops in the kitchen and bathrooms. The goal is for potential buyers to envision themselves living there, not you. This helps them connect emotionally with the space.

step.name: Step 3: Arrange Furniture for Flow and Space – Ensure furniture is arranged to maximize space and create a clear path for movement. Too much furniture can make rooms feel smaller. Consider removing any pieces that block natural light or make a room feel cramped. This creates an inviting and spacious impression.
step.text: Step 3: Arrange Furniture for Flow and Space – Ensure furniture is arranged to maximize space and create a clear path for movement. Too much furniture can make rooms feel smaller. Consider removing any pieces that block natural light or make a room feel cramped. This creates an inviting and spacious impression.

step.name: Step 4: Maximize Lighting and Views – Open all blinds and curtains to let in as much natural light as possible. Make sure all light bulbs are working and are of the same color temperature (no mixed warm and cool lights). Clean windows are crucial for showcasing those gorgeous South Florida views. Clear window sills of any obstructions.

step.name: Step 5: Address Exterior & Common Areas (Condo Specific) – For condos, this means cleaning balconies, arranging outdoor furniture neatly, and ensuring any potted plants are tidy. If your unit includes access to common amenities, verify they are accessible and looking their best, as they might be part of the shoot. Coordinate building access for your photographer.

step.name: Step 6: Coordinate Access and Features – Make sure all lights, ceiling fans, blinds, and even fireplaces are in working order and easily accessible for the photographer to adjust. Ensure all cars are out of the driveway or garage (if applicable) and that any pets are secured or removed during the shoot. This prevents delays and ensures smooth operation during the shoot.
step.text: What to Expect During the Process: While standard photography can be delivered quickly, luxury productions might need multiple capture windows, twilight scheduling, or even aerial coordination. The photographer will typically review coverage with you before they leave. A clear brief covering property features and intended use will help them capture exactly what you need. Kelby Contreras ensures meticulous coordination with top-tier photographers to get these details right, guaranteeing your property is shown in its absolute best light.
